target: 05 Technical architecture/Recovery Workbench Technical Specifications by Module v6/Recovery Workbench TSD P10 Agent runtime v3.md

fixes.old: No case state machine of its own; the module acts on events from P3 and writes through the decision log.
fixes.new: The 60-second limit applies to the whole AgentRunWorkflow, not to the model call alone (GAP-0076; NFR-010). The timer starts when the workflow starts, so the tool reads, the model call and the guardrail check all run inside it. A run that has not passed its guardrails at 60 s falls back and the rule result is used. The agent policy row (`agent_policy`) publishes the split of this time into a tool budget and a model budget. The budget values and their field names: Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0076).

fixes.old: | P5 rwb-document, S1 rwb-valuation, S8 rwb-deviation | Runs on rwb-agent |
fixes.new: | P5 rwb-document, S1 rwb-valuation, S8 rwb-deviation | Runs on rwb-agent; the 60 s covers the whole workflow, from its start to passed guardrails (T4) |

fixes.old: Every operation of T5.2.1 is authorised through the `rwb-access` authorise contract with the role, the scope and the delegation limit of T6.1 (DP-08; C RWB-P4-E1037-CON); the caller caches the answer and refreshes it on AccessPolicyChanged and DoaLimitChanged.
fixes.new: A change to a prompt or a policy (the writes Architecture v5 names `/agent-policies`, published here as POST `/admin/agent-configs` and POST `/admin/agent-configs/{versionId}/approve`) is authorised through the `rwb-access` authorise contract (DP-08) and takes effect only with a maker-checker approval from P7 (GAP-0075). The run row (`agent_run`) records the approving role. The center of excellence owns prompts, policies and evaluation sets and proposes changes; the roles that make and approve a change are to be named with the center of excellence. Those role codes, the P7 approval contract and the `agent_run` field that holds the approving role: Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0075).

disposition.note: 60 s set on the whole AgentRunWorkflow in T4 and T5.2.1. Tool/model budget values and field names are not given by the sources and are marked as such.
T6.2 states DP-08 authorise plus P7 maker-checker and the approving role on the run row. Role codes, P7 contract and field name are still to be named.
